integrity: The proof and supplementary calculations are original to this package; cited literature is acknowledged. Same-model scientific review only; no independent validation or experimental certification.
scientific_limitations: Strictly theoretical noiseless full-line stationary-transect inverse; requires unit-gain causal response, nowhere-zero Fourier factors, same sensor/field and two known distinct constant speeds. No noise stability, finite-route inversion or field validation.
title: Two different traversal speeds identify an unknown causal sensor response and a stationary pollutant profile
